QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Bruce, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with his work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p206##k, a resident of the town. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the townspeople is a given, right?\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p206#, a resident of #m10001000#. I have a feeling we're going to get along great!

0.0: "Since you've become a resident of #m10001000#, it would be a good idea to go greet the people here. As it happens, I've been wondering how #p206# is doing lately, so please go say hello to #p206#.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Yes, I am #p206#. What can I do for you? Ah, you must be #h0#, the newest resident of our town. Haha, a very warm welcome to you!
1.1: I am a biologist researching the animals and monsters around this town. I might need to ask for your assistance with my research sometime in the future. Well, I look forward to getting along with you!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, I must say.
